title: The same two AI gateway/SDK packages added the right way: exact versions and artifact hashes in the lock, --require-hashes kept, wheels' file lists compared with their tags, release ages well past the cooldown (clean control)

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import re
r = open("requirements.txt").read()
assert r.count("--hash=sha256:") == 5 and "agent-orchestrator==0.9.4" in r and "tool-sdk==2.3.1" in r
assert "--require-hashes" in open("Dockerfile").read()

PYEND
